Game Overview

Color Tower is a arcade title where test your timing and coordination skills by building a skyscraper in Color Tower. Tap to drop vibrantly colored boxes with precision. As levels increase, so does the challenge. Missteps shrink your boxes, pushing your stacking prowess to new heights. Aim carefully and see how high you can build!
